notes: M07-06 source review register. One entry per source family actually collected, recording terms, redistribution, attribution, personal-data fields, retention, contact, and per-capability scope. Capabilities listed as unauthorized/unsupported are deliberately NOT collected. No credentials appear here. References [P01]-[P13] are revalidated per connector before enabling it.

sources.notes: Baseline, forge-independent. Emails are personal data and are not published; report uses repo-local raw identity counts only.

Bounded native non-Git adapter (M08). Node ids are Mercurial hashes, never Git hashes; author strings are raw evidence, not accounts. --repo captures hg log -Tjson with source/stderr evidence, while the gate uses a controlled shim; parser is exercised against the captured shape plus adversarial payloads.
Release-only adapter (M08). Reports releases, published time and artifact metadata; no commits or authors are invented and retention is explicitly unavailable.

M03 package/version-string and full-commit queries run only on explicit invocation. Optional single-query continuation follows at most four pages, retains each request/raw response/status/stderr and digest, and marks a capped result partial with its remaining cursor. Explicit graph batches submit at most 64 versioned registry nodes to /v1/querybatch; path/Git and versionless nodes are counted as skipped and excess eligible nodes are counted as omitted. Opt-in graph continuation follows only results with cursors for at most four rounds, retains each page with its original query indexes, and saves remaining work with partial state at the cap. Batch responses contain advisory ID/modification summaries without affected ranges. Opt-in hydration fetches unique URL-safe returned IDs through /v1/vulns/{id}, checks each returned record ID, retains per-record transport evidence, and caps work at 64 records, 32 MiB, 120 seconds total, and 10 seconds per request; gaps stay partial. OSV documents version matching as fuzzy. Capture time does not establish feed freshness. OSV aggregates sources with different terms; follow record-level attribution and do not publicly redistribute advisory records. Complete lockfile coverage remains unauthorized. Official API and data-source docs reviewed 2026-09-20; this is an operational source-scope record, not legal advice.

Traffic API has a short window and strict restrictions [P01]; not collected. The bounded captured workflow-event adapter retains issue/proposal/review/release metadata, native IDs/status, timestamps, and links but not titles or bodies. Authenticated collaborator snapshots retain only normalized actor IDs and role declarations in the role input; adjacent raw endpoint pages retain login/native-ID evidence under the declared 365-day retention. The collaborator list reflects the authenticated caller's visible permissions, including organization/team grants, and is marked complete only after a short page. Webhooks are freshness-only.

Merge requests preserve native states; none are renamed to GitHub terms. The bounded captured workflow-event adapter retains native IDs/status, timestamps, and links but not titles or bodies; live authenticated pagination remains outside this review.
Self-hosted base URL is configured per controlled instance, not hardcoded to one domain.
Own connector id and fixtures despite shared utilities with forgejo.

Bounded native non-Git adapter (M08). Revisions are repository-global counters, never per-project change counts or Git hashes; author strings are raw evidence, not accounts. --repo captures svn log --xml -v with source/stderr evidence, while the gate uses a controlled shim; parser is exercised against the captured shape plus fail-closed adversarial payloads.

Bounded native non-Git adapter (M08). Check-in artifact ids are Fossil SHA-1/SHA-256 hashes, never Git hashes; author logins are raw evidence, not accounts. --repo captures fossil timeline -F with source/stderr evidence, while the gate uses a controlled shim; parser is exercised against the captured shape plus fail-closed adversarial payloads.

Bitbucket Cloud; repo identity is the uuid string, timestamps carry fractional seconds with a +00:00 offset. No documented repo traffic/clone API, so traffic is unauthorized/unsupported, never estimated.
Bounded RubyGems versions metadata only. Source and homepage URIs remain assertions; the adapter does not resolve gems or execute installation scripts.

Bounded NuGet registration metadata only. The adapter retains listed/yanked state, publication time, project URL assertions, and dependency declarations; it does not resolve ranges or execute package content.

Captured deps.dev version adapter only; live transport remains disabled. Origin and field coverage stay explicit, and the provider response never replaces the local dependency graph. Revalidate API and data rights before enabling transport.

personal_data_fields: maintainer identities or contact details when present in raw package lookup responses
sources.notes: M03-10 live transport revalidated 2026-09-20 against the official first-call, authentication, and licence docs [P28]-[P31]. One explicit package-name/ecosystem lookup uses the fixed /packages/lookup route; only exact returned coordinates are emitted and near-match candidates are counted as rejected. The anonymous common pool is shared, can return 429, and is not retried or batched. Only allowlisted package metadata is emitted; unknown provider fields, including maintainer identities/contact details that may appear in the retained raw response, are never published. The result credits ecosyste.ms, links CC BY-SA 4.0, and states that fields were filtered. Public adaptations must preserve share-alike terms; this implementation does not grant an exception or decide whether a particular downstream use is covered. Provider identifiers, source links and manifest locators are enrichment evidence and candidate mappings, never canonical identity.
Bounded PKGBUILD assignment parser. Shell functions are not sourced or executed; substitutions and declared dependency expressions remain visible rather than being resolved.
